create_station_voices.ponder.announcer_b: The Redstone Announcer plays custom text-to-speech voice announcements
Right-click the block to configure text, voice, pitch, reverb, and effects
Power the Announcer with a Redstone signal to trigger the announcement
While playing, the announcer lights up and broadcasts audio to nearby players
Optional jingles (such as DB Gong) can be configured to play before, after, or both!
create_station_voices.ponder.configurabl: The Configurable Announcer automates announcements for your train network
Right-click a Station or Track Observer with the Announcer item to link it
In the UI, use 'Auto-Fetch' to automatically populate trains scheduled for this station
Each train can have completely customized announcement text, voice, and effects
When a scheduled train arrives, the Announcer triggers automatically!
create_station_voices.ponder.train_annou: The Train-Mounted Announcer is placed directly on train carriages
Right-click to configure announcements for each arriving station, even while assembled
Use 'Auto-Fetch' to automatically load stations from the train schedule
Upon arriving at a configured station, the announcer plays inside the train!
Enable 'Train Only' in the effects tab so only passengers on the train hear the broadcast
create_station_voices.ponder.speaker_blo: Speakers act as secondary audio sources for Announcer blocks
Right-click any Announcer with the Speaker item in hand to link them
When the Announcer plays, all linked Speakers broadcast the audio simultaneously!
Distribute speakers around stations and platforms so announcements are heard everywhere
create_station_voices.ponder.announcer_d: Display Links can read announcements from Announcer blocks
First, right-click the target display board, sign, or nixie tube...
...then place the Display Link against an Announcer block
In the interface, customize the label and choose between 'While Playing' or 'Keep Displayed'
When an announcement is played, the fitting text is immediately sent to the display!
This works with Redstone Announcers, Configurable Train Announcers, and linked Speakers
